key.name: host
key.description: Hostname or IP address of the netsocket server, without scheme or port.

key.name: port
key.description: TCP port the netsocket server listens on.

key.name: use-https
key.description: Connect using wss:// / https:// instead of ws:// / http://.

key.name: response-timeout-seconds
key.description: How long to wait for an agent reply before marking a command palette message as timed out.

key.name: device-name
key.description: Name shown for this device in the dashboard's device list. Defaults to the hostname if empty.

key.name: notify-on-reply
key.description: Show a desktop notification when a command palette reply arrives while the window is closed.
